zeus.explanation: Most versatile unit in the game, can be used everywhere. Requires substat investment to be used on high chapters. (Shouldn't be that big of a problem considering he is #1 prio)

nezha.explanation: Strongest PvE dps for both odyssey and spire can clear early odyssey with 4 lvl 1s, still feels like least dependant carry substat wise while being most versatile in PvE.

cronus.explanation: Best support in the game does everything, full kit unlocked pretty much at base dupe. Relic is nice to have but not needed.
cronus.f2pInvestment: Base dupe, work on dupes after zeus / nezha

nuwa.explanation: Best tank in the game, can perma cc, can share damage between your units, can perma cc enemies and works at base dupe for all of that.
nuwa.f2pInvestment: Base dupe wait or grab from mindsea

amunra.explanation: With relic 30, borrowed gear from zeus and while paired with meret/caishen can deal with a lot of teams, flexible other 2 spots. Has some units he wants to avoid fighting such as yanluo.
amunra.f2pInvestment: Free unit work on via shards / mindsea / after zeus for dupes.

dionysus.explanation: One of the few energy batteries game has, has insane buffs but survival issues. If u can keep her alive its highest dps increasing support atm.
dionysus.f2pInvestment: Base dupe wait till it randomly drops

nyx.explanation: One of the most broken PvP units in entire game that can hard carry early game PvE but is falls off later on and is mostly used as subdps/tech.
nyx.f2pInvestment: Base dupe wait till it randomly drops

skadi.explanation: Closest dps to a celestial that we have in game currently, can clear most of teams. and doesn't contest teammates with hecate or any other meta team.

poseidon.explanation: Most accessible and best grouping tool aside amun, mres shred. Biggest performance jump out of all units at relic 10.

hecate.explanation: Only carry aside jingwei that can be used up till late game from standard units. Forms a core with yuelao+momus. Doesn't contest teammates with other carries.

khepri.explanation: Tech unit, used to push and group alongside poseidon. Decently tanky with relic investment.

tefnut.explanation: Good support, has 50% aoe dmg reduction and can cleanse debuffs. Pushback/mres shred are nice.

hephaestus.explanation: Caishen 2.0, with more offensive buffs and utility as tradeoff for less energy and slower snowball potential. Fits a lot of teams that can frontline and let him do his stuff from the backline. Mandatory buffer for higher odyssey/heart spire.

momus.explanation: Best tank from standard units, does a lot of damage while tanking. Upgrade relic when you feel comfortable to invest in it or when team. starts to struggle. His stats = Carry stats if used with yue.

iris.explanation: Has a bit of cc and dmg buff in aoe, can be used alongside poseidon. to buff aoe dps.

hela.explanation: Used with amun to counteract the insane deficit of 61+, if one thing falls and. u steal portion of those ludicrous stats she starts doing dmg. Really inflexible in terms of teammates and expensive but does her job as a dps.

nemesis.explanation: Very rng based damage, will dash and instantly die at higher deficits. Completely unusable 61+.

meret.explanation: Best damage buffer in the game second only to dio but unlike dio. provides insane survivability to allies and can tank herself. Isn't prone to jumping into enemy and dying like dio either. Requires to properly connect sun and moon targets.

heracles.explanation: Carry unit in yellow team. Groups up enemy and does 2 big bursts of damage, avoid using into pan. Prio slot 2/4 for upgrading. Unusable as a dps in late (purely a grouping tool)

bastet.explanation: Recommended frontline unit, can be a solo carry up until 5 teams. Need to get some dodge% on slot 2/3.

phoenix.explanation: Good damage early on, subdps later on with infinite lives. Later used purely as nezha relic fodder.

set.explanation: Lifesteal/Atk% buffer. Can be used as armor shred for diamond team.

athena.explanation: Used as a zeus buffer when you get divine zeus. high attack speed buff that benefits zeus judgement. (MUST invest in relic 20 if u have divine zeus)

sekhmet.explanation: Can be used to push enemy for grouping but thats all. Pretty useless overall.

ares.explanation: His immortality can come in handy with relic 20 for odyssey 61+ where. everything is one shotting u with a basic attack.

geb.explanation: Used as a cc tool with amun to counter certain units. Still very unecessary unit to progress, likely to be replaced in future in. his role as its nothing special in the first place.

horus.explanation: Enemy horus executes your entire team after flying up, your jumps and dies.

wenshen.explanation: Very good tech unit, staple for nezha team in odyssey. Has some tech use in spire. Her jinx debuff has higher prio than enemy skills so it can cancel super armor ones like artemis.

nuba.explanation: Good offtank subdps, has plenty of utility in kit. Overall a good unit. If lacking investment on dupes/relic she will just give enemy free energy.

anubis.explanation: Execute mechanic is pretty good, can chesse quite a few units to not revive via it.

pan.explanation: Plenty of cc in kit, one of only units with energy removal. Can be used to perma cc teams so they never ult.

jormungandr.explanation: Purely a grouping tool / bait for anubis ults. Can one shot units in pvp.

diana.explanation: Energy battery with high attack speed buff. Zeus/Nezha pet later on. Works at 1 dupe as battery, invest in relic when u have divine zeus or if u are using nezha as carry.

capricorn.explanation: Mainly used as a tech unit for positioning, requires good understanding of how units act at start of. fight. Used for grouping.

fengyi.explanation: Early game race carry, has no use outside of that. If u get lucky use her to place high then switch her out.

artemis.explanation: As enemy her arrows instakill you but when you use her does 0 dmg.

demeter.explanation: Useless when on your team, times u out on enemy.

freya.explanation: Has 0 utility and just has healing which is useless, if u win with freya u could've won with empty slot.

mengpo.explanation: Infinite revives, battery, cc, dmg buffs, untargetable. Support with almost no weakness and with most complete kit a support could have.

caishen.explanation: Best energy battery in the game, used everywhere.

yuelao.explanation: Buffer/damage share unit tied with hecate and momus to form a trio carry comp for odyssey. At 61+ gets split from hecate, sometimes still ran with momus sometimes with other units.

cancer.explanation: One of the few energy batteries game has, best and only useful zodiac game has. Gives frontline energy and super armor.

jingwei.relicRecommendation: If going for zeus 10-20 / If not going for zeus 20-30
jingwei.explanation: Only carry aside hecate that is able to carry a team on her own from standard units that isn't a celestial up to T4 gear. Eventually will be power crept but not something to worry about as of right now considering she is easily accessible and cheap to make work. Borrow her zeus gear instead of awakening her own gear.

hladgunnr.explanation: Meatshield. Invest in relic 30 only if prepared for the investment needed afterwards. (awakening substats) or for heart spire.

yanluo.explanation: Tech unit, use when necessary for grouping enemies or messing up their skills.

prometheus.explanation: Just unlock the relic for the cage drop, tech unit for pushback/taking aggro.

isis.explanation: Free unit, can be used first few days for stages but is easily replacable. 2nd best bossing unit after zeus but for both f2p and whales its a troll investment.
isis.f2pInvestment: Can rush divine for 5 lvl 300 early game.

ullr.explanation: Protection unit for PvP carry such as nezha.
ullr.f2pInvestment: Get divine after everyone above is divine.

surtr.explanation: No use, garbage multipliers, garbage kit
surtr.f2pInvestment: Get divine after everyone above is divine.

serket.explanation: Backline access. Does no damage on its own but can stall regardless of deficit for some of the longest periods of all frontliners we have in the game. Recommended to build for PvP/Later odyssey as frontliner.

hera.explanation: Works for most players even with one copy. But she really shines when she gets more love and upgrades. But for that you need to have her at exalted+ and above. Then with her relic at 30 she becomes a really good deity.
